title: SciCoQA: Quality Assurance for Scientific Paper--Code Alignment

live_model.id_in_text: GPT-5 Mini (gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07); GPT-5 (gpt-5-2025-08-07) also used to build ground truth
live_model.evidence: Table 3: 'GPT-5 Mini OpenAI (2025a) gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 272k May 2024 Aug 2025'; Sec. 5: 'Gemini 3.1 Pro and GPT-5 Mini perform best, achieving a recall of 46.7%'

prompt.location: Appendix F (prompt sections; F.7 is the matching-judge prompt); the detection prompt takes the paper text plus repository files

claim.location: Sec. 5 / Figure 4 / Table 10, row GPT-5 Mini, real subset (92 discrepancies from 72 papers)
claim.judge: llm:gpt-oss-20b (open-weight matching judge) plus EmbeddingGemma top-3 filter

data.source: SciCoQA, https://hf.co/datasets/ukplab/scicoqa (papers, versioned repository snapshots, 635 discrepancies)

notes: Inputs are whole papers plus code repositories (73 of 276 papers exceed 100k tokens); matching needs a hosted open-weight judge; reported values are means over five runs. GPT-5 also helps construct the ground truth (role A).

resolution.plan: Inputs are the markdown paper plus the processed repository snapshot (notebooks converted, file list prepended, prompt filled to 90% of context, whole files truncated from the end; A.5-A.6) with the F.6 detection prompt, and predictions are matched to ground truth by an EmbeddingGemma top-3 filter and a gpt-oss-20b judge (F.7); the file ordering/formatting and the matching pipeline are code in the released repository. Run gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 five times over the 72 real-discrepancy papers (hf.co/datasets/ukplab/scicoqa), match against the 92 discrepancies, and compare recall with 46.7 (Sec. 5 / Table 10).
resolution.approximation: Open-weight judge and embedding model hosted locally; five-run mean; ground truth partly built with GPT-5 (role A).
